messages:
fix: apply percentage coupons to the subtotal after volume discount

Coupon discounts were computed on the gross line amount instead of
the subtotal after the volume discount, so orders that had both
discounts lost less than the rules require (e.g. 12 notebooks at
€5.00 with a 10% coupon came to €48.00 instead of €48.60).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: honour a coupon through its last valid day

redeemable() rejected a coupon on its validUntil day itself, even
though the rules state a coupon is valid from its first day to its
last, both included. An order placed on the last day was refused as
expired.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
